title: Perfect Business Prompts
description: Prompt collection for founders, marketers, and business teams.
seoDescription: Use business prompts for strategy, growth, sales, and operations.
intro: Practical prompts for business decisions, planning, and growth.

prompts.title: Go-To-Market Plan
prompts.description: Build a launch strategy for new products.
prompts.text: Create a go-to-market plan for [product] targeting [audience], with channels, budget split, and KPIs.

prompts.title: Offer Optimization
prompts.text: Analyze this offer and improve value proposition, positioning, and pricing: [offer details].

prompts.title: Competitive Analysis
prompts.text: Perform competitor analysis for [industry], with strengths, weaknesses, and positioning gaps.

prompts.title: Sales Email Generator
prompts.text: Write a short sales email for [offer] to [target customer] focusing on pain points and ROI.

prompts.title: Weekly KPI Review
prompts.description: Create executive summary of business metrics.
prompts.text: Create a weekly KPI report format for [business], including top metrics, insights, and action items.

body:
Practical prompts for business decisions, planning, and growth.

Prompt collection for founders, marketers, and business teams.

Go-To-Market Plan

Build a launch strategy for new products.

Create a go-to-market plan for [product] targeting [audience], with channels, budget split, and KPIs.

Offer Optimization

Improve product offers for conversions.

Analyze this offer and improve value proposition, positioning, and pricing: [offer details].

Competitive Analysis

Map competitors and differentiation.

Perform competitor analysis for [industry], with strengths, weaknesses, and positioning gaps.

Sales Email Generator

Write persuasive outbound messages.

Write a short sales email for [offer] to [target customer] focusing on pain points and ROI.

Weekly KPI Review

Create executive summary of business metrics.

Create a weekly KPI report format for [business], including top metrics, insights, and action items.
